encounters.title: The Intelligence Report
encounters.description: The briefing room aboard The Iron Paw is cold steel and discipline. An intelligence officer slides a holographic dossier across the table. 'Commander Dave, sir. We've intercepted Corsair chatter. A cat pirate has found something — an energy source in the fringe nebulae. Whisper Crystals. If the reports are accurate, this changes everything.'

choices.text: Order a full intelligence analysis before acting. Know the enemy.

outcome.description: Dave studies every data point. The crystals resonate at frequencies that could revolutionise propulsion — or be weaponised. 'Preparation wins wars,' he tells his staff, filing the report under top priority.

choices.text: Scramble a patrol squadron immediately. Secure the region before the Corsairs dig in.

outcome.description: Dave barks orders and the hangar erupts with activity. Three cruisers launch within the hour. 'If we wait, we lose,' Dave thinks. The League's engines roar toward the fringe.

encounters.title: The Corsair Captain
encounters.description: A ragged Corsair vessel drops out of warp — nimble, scarred, practically held together by audacity. The comms channel opens and a smirking cat in a battered captain's coat appears on screen.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Commander Dave, I presume? Word travels fast in the multiverse. I'm Aristotle. You're in my neighbourhood.

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: I know who you are. A smuggler playing at captain. The League has a file on you thicker than your hull plating.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: A file! I'm flattered. I hope they got my good side. So, Commander — what brings the League's finest all the way out to my little corner of nothing?

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: Whisper Crystals. You have them. The League needs them. That's all that matters.

choices.text: You are in possession of strategic resources. Surrender them to the League. This is not a negotiation.

outcome.description: Aristotle's ears flatten, then he laughs. 'A dog who barks orders at a cat. How original.' The channel cuts. Dave stares at the blank screen. This pirate will not bend easily.

choices.text: The League can offer protection, supplies, and legitimacy. What do you want for the crystals?

outcome.description: Aristotle tilts his head. 'A dog with manners. Interesting.' A small shipment of crystals arrives, along with an itemised invoice that borders on robbery. But contact is established.

choices.text: I'm here to observe. The League keeps its options open.

outcome.description: Aristotle narrows his eyes. 'A dog who watches before he bites. Noted.' The channel closes. Dave has shown nothing — and learned everything about the pirate's bravado.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Ha! 'Not a negotiation,' he says. You dogs really are all bark, aren't you? Tell you what, Commander — come take them. I dare you.

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: You think this is a game. It isn't. The League doesn't make threats. It makes promises.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Promises, threats — same coin, different side. You want my crystals? Get in line. Every faction in the multiverse wants a piece. At least the others brought gifts.

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: Remember this conversation, pirate. When the League blockade closes around your little empire, you'll wish you'd listened.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Now we're talking! A dog with manners. I didn't think they made those anymore. Protection, you say? Supplies? Legitimacy?

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Tell you what — I'll send a small shipment. Consider it a... free sample. The invoice will follow. You won't like the invoice.

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: I don't need to like it. I need the crystals. Send your terms. The League will review them.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Review away, Commander. But don't take too long. My dance card fills up fast, and there are plenty of factions who'd love to be my new best friend.

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: We'll be in touch. Dave out.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Observe? That's it? You flew all this way, brought your big shiny warship into my space, and you just want to... watch?

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: Information is the most valuable resource in any campaign. You of all people should understand that.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: A dog who watches before he bites. Noted. Well, enjoy the view, Commander. It's quite something out here in the fringe.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Just remember — I'll be watching you right back. And cats have much better eyes in the dark.

encounters.title: Ghost Frequency
encounters.description: The Iron Paw's comms officer frowns at her console. 'Commander, we're picking up a signal on a dead frequency — one the Corsairs haven't used in decades. It's... a purr, sir. A low-frequency resonance. And it's coming from inside Corsair space.' Dave leans forward. Something is very wrong within the Felid ranks.

choices.text: Dispatch a stealth probe to track the signal source. Intelligence is everything.

outcome.description: The probe returns fragmented data — a ship with ancient Corsair markings, moving like a phantom. Someone inside the Corsair faction is operating off-book. Dave files the data. 'If there's a fracture in their ranks, we can exploit it.'

choices.text: Log it and move on. We have bigger concerns than Corsair internal politics.

outcome.description: Dave waves it off, but the comms officer logs the frequency anyway. Hours later, another pulse arrives — closer this time. Whatever it is, it knows Dave is watching.

encounters.title: Corsair Ambush
encounters.description: Alarms blare across the bridge. Three Corsair raiders drop out of warp on an intercept course, their weapons already hot. 'League vessel, you're trespassing in free space!' spits a voice. 'Dump your cargo and maybe we'll let you limp home.'

choices.text: 'All hands to battle stations. Show these pirates what League discipline looks like.'

outcome.description: The Iron Paw's guns thunder. League training versus Corsair cunning. The raiders scatter under coordinated fire — one limps away trailing smoke.

choices.text: Open a League authority channel. 'This vessel is under Canis League protection. Stand down or be reported.'

outcome.description: The raiders hesitate — League retaliation is systematic and thorough. They break off, cursing on open channels. Dave exhales. Not every fight needs to be fought.

encounters.title: Scrap Wolves
encounters.description: A swarm of cobbled-together goblin ships erupts from a debris field, their comms a cacophony of shrieks and laughter. They don't care about politics — they want metal, fuel, and anything not bolted down.

choices.text: Form firing line. One concentrated volley should scatter them.

outcome.description: Disciplined League gunnery tears through the ramshackle fleet. The survivors flee, leaving a trail of sparking debris.

choices.text: Jettison our scrap reserves as a decoy. Let them fight over it.

outcome.description: The goblins immediately abandon their attack run, squabbling over the jettisoned scrap. Predictable creatures. Dave notes the tactic for future reference.

encounters.title: The Commander's Orders
encounters.description: Dave stands before the tactical holo-map in the war room. The crystal situation is clear: a pirate controls the fuel supply, shadows move in Corsair space, and the League High Command is demanding results. His officers wait for orders. Every path from here reshapes the campaign.

choices.text: 'We blockade the crystal regions. Starve them out. The League controls the lanes.'

outcome.description: Dave's officers salute and deploy. A ring of League cruisers forms around the fringe nebulae. No crystal moves without League approval. It's clean, efficient, and utterly uncompromising.

choices.text: 'We negotiate access. Crystals flow through League markets. Everyone profits — under our terms.'

outcome.description: Dave sends trade envoys instead of warships. It's slower, less dramatic, but sustainable. The League will become the crystal market — and markets are harder to attack than fleets.

choices.text: 'We plant operatives inside the Corsair network. Know their moves before they make them.'

outcome.description: Dave's intelligence officers move like shadows into Corsair ports. The information flows slowly at first, then in a torrent. Dave knows more about Aristotle's operation than Aristotle does.
